name: Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench: MI250 x4 (TP), vLLM 0.6.1, Llama-2-70B FP16, 128in/128out, batch 1
unit: tok/s aggregate (batch 1, single request over 4x MI250 TP)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench, arXiv:2411.00136, All_results.csv). vLLM benchmark_throughput.py, FP16/BF16, 128 in / 128 out. Throughput = batch*(in+out)/end-to-end latency = AGGREGATE over the batch, NOT per-request decode. Batch 1, 4x MI250 tensor-parallel (single Polaris node, Infinity Fabric). Latency 5.363s.
notes: 70B FP16 does not fit on one MI250 (140GB weights vs 128GB); TP=4 required. Per-request latency ~5.4s for 128 out.
